title: The critic subagents installed in a project cannot read the critic contract: the release ships no copy of critics.md, no critic's agent.md points at it, and no CLI command serves it
body:
**THE CRITIC SUBAGENTS INSTALLED IN A PROJECT CANNOT READ THE CONTRACT THEY WORK UNDER.** `intent/docs/critics.md` is the critic contract (the Critic Family section of the generated AGENTS.md names it), and it exists only in Intent's source tree. The brew keg carries no copy (checked on 3.3.3's, `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/intent/3.3.3/libexec`). No critic's `agent.md` under `intent/plugins/claude/subagents/` points at it. And `intent claude` serves the rules (`intent claude rules list` and `show`), not the contract. A critic running in another project therefore works to a contract it cannot open.

**History.** vc todo 65, from hv's decision 89 (2026-10-25, relayed by molt-vc): making the critic contract readable to installed subagents waited until after 3.2.7. It was not built by 3.3.3. hv ruled on 2026-11-17 (hv decision 59) that it rides the next release.

**There are two contract documents, not one.** `intent/plugins/claude/rules/_schema/critic-contract.md` already ships in the keg and calls itself "the canonical schema-side definition", with `critics.md` as "the user-facing reference" (found by ic on 2026-11-17). ST0088 AC-03.2, as vc narrowed it under hv's pen on 2026-10-25, took out the clause making each critic's `agent.md` its delta over `rules/_schema/critic-contract.md` and pointing at it. It went only because an installed subagent is one file under the config dir and could not reach the contract. "Making the contract reachable is a follow-up on vc's board", which was vc todo 65 and is this issue.

**What a fix has to do, in one unit.** (1) The contract keeps one home. cc chooses which of the two documents it is: `critic-contract.md` already ships in the rules tree and AC-03.2 names it, while `critics.md` is the one more places name. The other's still-true content folds into it, the other file goes, and every reference to it moves. (2) An installed critic reads that home from the installed Intent, as it reads its rules, through a verb that reads the file and never a copy. (3) With the contract reachable, AC-03.2's clause comes back: each critic's `agent.md` carries only its delta over the contract and points at the verb. Owner: ic, for the shape (the verb, the shipped set and the six `agent.md` files), with cc for the meaning (which document is the home, and what each critic's delta is).
